repos_data.description: MetaTrader 5 in a real Windows VM (Docker + QEMU/KVM), driven over REST + MCP — programmatic trading plus server-side TA: OHLC bars enriched with RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/VWAP/Ichimoku/Order Blocks/FVGs (primitives, not signals). Typed MCP tools mirror the whole surface. Multi-broker, multi-account. No Wine bullshit.
Runnable Python examples for MT4/MT5 trading via TradeMux — no MQL, no custom bridge.

C++ 17 based library (with sample applications) for testing equities, futures, currencies, etfs & options based automated trading ideas using DTN IQFeed real time data feed and Interactive Brokers (IB TWS API) for trade execution. libtorch/lstm/cuda demo. Support for Alpaca & Phemex. Notifications via Telegram.
Backtestable AI trading agents and Python algorithmic trading strategies for stocks, options, crypto, futures, forex, SEC filings, FRED macro data, and real brokers.

Dumb-as-rocks OHLC analyzer. POST your bars + the indicators you want, get back exactly what you asked for. RSI/MACD/Bollinger/ADX/ATR/VWAP/Ichimoku, plus SMC primitives: Order Blocks, FVGs, BOS/CHoCH, swing structure. Stateless HTTP + MCP, no database, no AI-powered signals, no $97/mo Discord upsell.
Automated trading system for NOPE strategy over IBKR TWS
205 pay-per-call MCP tools via x402 — no API keys. Stocks, crypto/DeFi, macro data, on-chain analytics, weather, government data, and 200+ more. USDC on Base.
Let Claude manage your tastytrade portfolio.

The finmap.org MCP server provides comprehensive historical data from the US, UK, Russian and Turkish stock exchanges. Access sectors, tickers, company profiles, market cap, volume, value, and trade counts, as well as treemap and histogram visualizations
Read-only crypto market data MCP server (price, funding rates, open interest, long/short, order book, candles) across major exchanges via CCXT.
